input.goal: In the meantime, prepare the puff pastry. Roll out the puff pastry to about 10 inches by 14 inches, then cut into squares.

sub_goals.text: Clear space and arrange the muffin trays
Unroll and prepare the puff pastry
Mark the puff pastry using the muffin tray as a guide
Cut the puff pastry into squares
Apply butter to the muffin tray divots
Rub the butter evenly into the muffin tray divots
Place and shape the first batch of puff pastry squares into the muffin tray
Continue placing and shaping puff pastry squares into the muffin tray
Finish placing and shaping puff pastry squares into the muffin tray

plan.goal: In the meantime, prepare the puff pastry. Roll out the puff pastry to about 10 inches by 14 inches, then cut into squares.

events.description: The person clears items away to make space on the counter.
events.relevance: provides a clean workspace for the pastry

events.description: The muffin trays are placed onto the cleared counter space.
events.relevance: prepares the baking equipment for use

events.description: The puff pastry sheet is unrolled flat onto the counter.
events.relevance: prepares the pastry for measuring and cutting

events.description: A rustling sound is heard as the pastry packaging or parchment paper is manipulated.
events.relevance: indicates the handling of the pastry roll

events.description: The muffin tray is placed directly over the unrolled puff pastry.
events.relevance: positions the tray to act as a measuring guide

events.description: The person presses or marks the pastry using the tray to outline the squares.
A knife or cutter slices through the puff pastry along the marked lines.
events.relevance: divides the pastry into the required portions

events.description: The single sheet of puff pastry is now separated into multiple individual squares.
Butter is applied into the individual divots of the muffin tray.
events.relevance: introduces the grease needed to prevent sticking

events.description: Fingers or a tool rub the butter evenly around the inside surface of each divot.
events.relevance: ensures the entire baking surface is greased

events.description: A cut puff pastry square is picked up and placed into a buttered muffin tray divot.
events.relevance: moves the prepared ingredient into the baking vessel

events.description: The pastry square is pressed down to conform to the shape of the divot.
events.relevance: forms the pastry into a cup shape for filling

sub_goals.irrelevant: This sub-goal is a direct continuation of the exact same placing and shaping actions from the previous sub-goal, yielding no new expected events.

events.description: The final pastry squares are placed and pressed into the last remaining empty divots.
events.relevance: completes the task of lining the tray

relations.ask: What is the muffin tray placed on top of?
relations.answer_hint: The puff pastry sheet that was just unrolled onto the counter.

relations.ask: What substance is being rubbed into the tray divots?
relations.answer_hint: The butter that was just applied to them.

decision_points.why: The workspace is prepared, so the person must decide to transition to handling the main ingredient (the pastry).
The pastry is unrolled, and the person must decide on a method to measure it, choosing to use the tray as a guide.
Marking is complete, requiring a tool switch and a decision to begin the cutting phase.
Cutting is finished, and the person must realize the tray needs to be greased before the pastry can be placed.
Applying butter naturally and immediately leads to rubbing it in; it is part of a single continuous greasing action.
The tray is fully greased, requiring a transition back to the pastry to begin assembling the pieces.
This is merely a continuation of the repetitive placing and shaping process.
This is just the conclusion of the exact same repetitive placing action.
The tray is fully lined with pastry, completing the current goal. The person must now decide what the next recipe step is, such as preparing a filling.
